rationale: The stock is sitting at 94.7% of its intraday range with only 37 minutes to close, showing extremely tight consolidation in the last five 1-minute candles (range of roughly $0.07) with declining volume — no clear directional momentum to exploit. The wide bid-ask spread of 111.7 bps creates an immediate structural disadvantage, and with the price already up ~26% from today's low and near the session high, the risk/reward for a long is poor while a short against a strong uptrend with no news catalyst is equally unattractive. With today already showing a realized loss, the prudent action is to avoid a low-conviction late-session trade in a thinly moving, wide-spread name.
